{{Use New Zealand English|date=April 2019}}
The '''1992 New Zealand National Soccer League''' was the 23rd season of a nationwide [[Round-robin tournament|round-robin]] club competition in [[New Zealand]] football. It was the final season of the first incarnation of the league — it was replaced from the [[1993 Superclub competition|1993 season]] by the [[Superclub competition]].

==Promotion and relegation==
[[Gisborne City]] were relegated at the end of the 1991 season, to be replaced by the winner of a play-off series between the winners of the northern, central, and southern leagues ([[Papatoetoe (soccer)|Papatoetoe]], [[Wellington Olympic]], and [[Dunedin City AFC|Dunedin City]] respectively). Dunedin City opted not to take part, citing travel costs as a reason. Papatoetoe beat Wellington Olympic to be promoted to the league for 1992.<ref name="rsssf91">{{cite web | url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesn/nz91.html | title=New Zealand 1991 | website=[[RSSSF]] | accessdate=11 April 2019 }}</ref>

As the 1992 season was the league's last in this format, there was no relegation at the end of the competition.
